action.description: One atomic durative action (D3). `recipe_mediated: true` (Materials plan §0 'Recipe model — FINAL') marks a Craft-style action parameterized by a content/recipes.yaml recipe bound at plan time (D3 parametric): the recipe owns the input slots (wear|consume alternatives), the `ambient` stations, the per-recipe `duration`, the `basis_stat` outcome roll, and the outputs. Such an action MUST NOT set `produces_item` (the recipe owns outputs), MUST NOT set `target_kind` (its stations are the recipe's `ambient`, bound in-range by the world), and OMITS `duration` (the recipe supplies it). TOOL REQUIREMENTS (FINAL): a recipe-mediated action (Craft) has NO tool tag — a tool is a recipe input alternative with `mode: wear` (or `consume`). A NON-recipe action (Mine) expresses its tool need as an action-level `tool:<family>` tag (the actor must hold a matching tool); the world wears it (decrement current durability, break at 0) at a world/balance rate. There is NO `target_tags`/station action field. A non-recipe action MUST carry `duration` (enforced below).

target_kind.description: A specific objects.yaml object_kind id this action targets (Forage→berry_bush, Mine→ore_node). A recipe_mediated action has NO target_kind (its stations are the recipe `ambient`, bound in-range by the world).

produces_item.description: Item kind placed into inventory on completion (a FIXED single item; Forage→berries). MUST be absent when recipe_mediated is true (FINAL — the bound recipe's outputs replace it).

recipe_mediated.description: Materials plan §0 'Recipe model — FINAL'/D3: true marks an action (Craft) parameterized by a content/recipes.yaml RECIPE bound at plan time — the recipe owns the input slots (each `{any:[{tagQuery, amount, mode:wear|consume}…]}`), `ambient` stations, `duration`, `basis_stat`, and outputs. The action names no recipe (parametric) and carries NO tool tag, NO target_kind, and NO duration. When true, `produces_item`, `target_kind`, and `duration` MUST be absent.
